audience: event organizers who sell tickets with Ticketsauce and want answers about events, orders and check-ins

useCases.title: Review the events you are running
useCases.text: The AI lists your events with dates, venue, timezone and whether tickets are on sale, and opens one event to show how many tickets have been sold.

useCases.title: Review recent orders for an event
useCases.text: The AI lists the orders of one event placed in a time window, newest first, with totals, promo codes and ticket counts. Order replies are cached for up to an hour.

useCases.title: Find a buyer's order and tickets
useCases.text: The AI looks up an order by buyer email or last name and shows the buyer details, totals and each ticket with its type and redeemed state.

useCases.title: Audit promo code use
useCases.text: The AI lists the orders of an event that used a promo code or exceed a set amount, and sums the totals, refunds and fees for each group.

useCases.title: Pull check-in IDs for door reconciliation
useCases.text: The AI retrieves the check-in IDs of an event (cached 5 minutes) and the orders with ticket redeemed states (cached up to an hour), so you can reconcile the door count. The two can lag the live door.
